integral_complete_comparison: integral sampler + edgewise certifier, same reports
report_coupling: fixed PCG64 per seed/workload/epsilon/edge stream; each method advances only the selected edge; coupled across delta
formal_user_model: independent simulated fresh users; one RR bit each; no recruitment-rate claim
censoring: all budget-limited runs retained; T_all null if incomplete; report restricted mean min(T_all,budget) and completion fraction together
risk: any wrong certificate in entire run; risk delta once per method, never per query
primary_analysis: paired per-seed differences and ratios, all frozen cells, no primary-cell selection
compute: at most two processes, numerical threads one; elapsed and CPU plan/cert/update, peak RSS
purpose: Strengthen B3 with equal public prior mass on singleton, minimal-cut, simple-path, full-domain families; compare frozen original streams on every original/regular graph cell; no tuning after outcomes
